description: One month's numbers from the company's posted books, as the accounting overview shows them: revenue, expenses, net income, cash at the month's end and its change, net burn (the average monthly fall in cash over the three months ending that month; 0 and not_burning when cash grew) and runway in whole months. Leave month empty for the last complete month, or pass YYYY-MM for one the founder names. When has_activity is false the books have nothing posted yet: say so and quote no figure. Quote these figures as given; the books hold no recurring revenue or headcount, so never estimate them. Read-only.
name: updates_get_metrics_snapshot
title: Get Metrics Snapshot
